name: Belm (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Belm (a black cross and a red chain on white).
history: The colours white and black represent the city of Osnabrück and red and black the prince-bishopric of Osnabrück; the arms are placed on the third line, slightly overlapping the red stripes.

features.role: Belm arms — black cross and red chain on white
